gen-gf-federant-fs-rowan: Commanding Federant leads with just a light touch of stroke modulation, big and bold up top. Rowan takes over with literary warmth, its curves generously open, a serif that feels friendly across a couple of lines.
gen-gf-fondamento-fs-spline-sans: Relaxed Fondamento looks penned by hand, its c tips staying well clear of touching. But Spline Sans brings wide gaps and uniformly weighted strokes, contemporary and approachable, though lengthy paragraphs are a stretch.
gen-gf-fondamento-sora: Sora draws precise, geometric letters with no pressure swell at the corners and widely parted curves. Fondamento adds relaxed, graceful handwriting above it, lovely over a couple of lines.
gen-gf-ga-maamli-fs-rowan: Plain, bold, and commanding from the first glance. What stands out is how Ga Maamli keeps its strokes uniform while Rowan's thin lines stay respectable, best for text kept brief.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-epunda-slab: One-nib flair, drawn with open, flowing terminals. Gabarito lets its counters flow outward, while Epunda Slab, a dignified serif with a gaping c, settles into paragraphs with classic ease.
gen-gf-gaegu-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws every glyph as a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe. And Gaegu scribbles in with an inviting marker-like line, charming for a moment but not for lengthy paragraphs.
gen-gf-geostar-fs-rowan: Rowan reads in a literary, welcoming way, its curves generously open and thin strokes about half the weight of thick ones. Geostar commands with widely tracked letters; Rowan keeps the quieter lines friendly.
gen-gf-give-you-glory-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk hums along in a flat gray texture, each glyph a ribbon of constant width. Give You Glory adds a hand-drawn lilt with spacious terminals for quick reads.
gen-gf-gluten-fs-rowan: Rowan is literary and friendly, with generous curves and medium stroke contrast. But Gluten arrives plain and commanding, a display voice best saved for a brief run of text.
gen-gf-goblin-one-fs-paquito: Expressive Goblin One packs fat stems beside thread-fine hairlines. Paquito, a confident, approachable serif with little gap between lowercase and capitals, backs it up best in text kept brief.
